title: Bounded experiment result
description: The machine-readable record every bounded experiment must emit. One record per scenario execution. The comparator (docs/development/EXPERIMENT-PROTOCOL.md §5) consumes verdict, failureClass, and metrics; tools/validate-experiment-result.mjs enforces the shape.

scenario.description: Registry key from EXPERIMENT-PROTOCOL.md §4, or a path-qualified fixture command.

command.description: The exact command that produced this result. Must be re-runnable.

failureClass.description: Canonical outcome class; 'none' iff status=PASS. Maps to the emitted typed markers, never a free-text reason.

metrics.description: Scenario-declared measurements, e.g. verifiedTransitions, modelCalls, wallMs. Keys declared in the scenario row; unknown keys are allowed but ignored by the comparator.

evidence.description: Repo-relative paths to run-scoped artifacts (log, snapshot, decisions.jsonl).

verdict.description: Comparator decision per §5. KEEP requires status=PASS on every declared scenario plus zero new failureClass vs the base record set.

frozenZoneTouched.description: True iff the diff touches any §2 frozen-zone path. A true value forces verdict=ESCALATE.
